configured_suite.skip_policy: Raw record values copied unchanged, including Linux mknod Operation not permitted capability skips. SKIP is not PASS and these capability limits are not suppressed or rewritten.

coverage_interpretation: Current official mapping counts after adding the 30 newly executed regression refs; the source proof retains its earlier baseline counts and lists every new actual PASS ref separately. Original RED arrays are unchanged. Counts are not additive unique totals; missing_public empty establishes mapped public assertions only. non_public does not establish SDK execution. Normative zero-test/NA mappings are neither automatic failures nor approvals; require their own evidence.
